easyPrerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
